deviation_from_original_spec.actual: direct sendSmsRaw — bypasses processOutboundSend's test-lane guard, exercises prelaunch guard in isolation
deviation_from_original_spec.reason: First attempt with processOutboundSend was blocked by the test-lane guard with reason 'Request has test-lane marker but TESTLANE_MODE is not true (fail-closed)'. Root cause: the running PM2 process has TESTLANE_MODE=true (--update-env post-restart) but THIS tsx script process loads .env via dotenv/config and TESTLANE_MODE is not set there to true. The blocked attempt is captured as outbound_log row id 7bf57402-7dc4-4e32-9cc1-3b3909657a61 (status=blocked) and is part of the audit trail. Direct sendSmsRaw is a cleaner test of the prelaunch guard and mirrors Delta 2's structure for an A/B pair on the same code path.
